criteria.title: Structural instability documented
criteria.description: Imaging must support the requested fusion indication.
criteria.policyQuote: Imaging must demonstrate instability or another covered structural indication.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Nonoperative treatment completed
criteria.description: The treatment duration and response must be documented.
criteria.policyQuote: At least six months of clinically appropriate nonoperative treatment must be documented unless an exception applies.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Neurologic findings are consistent
criteria.description: Objective findings should be internally consistent.
criteria.policyQuote: Objective neurologic findings used to support surgery must be consistent across the submitted record.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Requested levels match the operative plan
criteria.description: The order and operative plan must identify the same levels.
criteria.policyQuote: The requested fusion levels must be consistent across the order and surgical plan.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.
